node.statement: Fix an arbitrary W, finite-dimensional exact-unit epsilon_r-C*-algebra, and delta>0 satisfying the root hypotheses for these thresholds. Since epsilon_r>=0, delta>0, B<=C_pol, P<=C_pol, and kappa_pol<=min(k,q), the root polar guard implies both B*(epsilon_r+delta)<=k and P*(epsilon_r+delta)<=q.
